name: Barbell Shrug
summary: A vertical shrug with a barbell that directly loads the upper trapezius and trains grip.
setup: Stand with feet hip width holding the barbell in front of the thighs with an overhand grip just outside the hips.
Stand tall with the chest up, shoulders relaxed and arms straight.
Brace the abs and keep the head neutral.
execution: Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly until the shoulders are fully relaxed down.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders: shrug straight up and down.
Bending the elbows to help: keep the arms straight and use lighter weight.
Bouncing with the legs: stand still and control the tempo.
Going too heavy with a short range: use a load that allows a full lift and pause.
